## Subjective

42yo F, no significant PMH, presents 2 days after lifting heavy box at work (location: lower back; quality: dull ache, muscle-feeling; severity: 6/10; duration: 2 days; timing: worse with bending; context: lifting; modifying factors: worse with movement). Denies radiation to legs, no numbness, no bladder/bowel changes, no fever. Tobacco: never.

## Objective

VS: BP 122/76, HR 80. Gen: ambulatory, mild discomfort. MSK back: paraspinal muscle tenderness L3-L5 b/l, no midline tenderness, no SI joint tenderness, ROM limited at end-range flexion. Neuro: motor 5/5 bilateral lower extremities, sensation intact, DTRs 2+ symmetric, SLR negative. Skin: no rash. CV: denies chest pain.

## Assessment

1. Acute mechanical low back strain (M54.5)

## Plan

No red flags identified — no imaging indicated. OTC ibuprofen 600mg q8h × 5 days with food, OTC acetaminophen alternating PRN. Heat/ice as preferred. Avoid heavy lifting × 1 week. Gentle stretching, walk daily as tolerated. Return immediately for: bladder/bowel symptoms, leg weakness, persistent fever, or pain worsening. F/u 2 weeks if not improved.
